restaurant_name: Mi-A Clinic มีอาคลินิกเวชกรรม 米娅医美诊所
text:
I had under-eye filler at Mi-A Clinic in Chiang Mai about one month ago and am disappointed with both the outcome and the overall experience.

Prior to the treatment, I clearly explained that my goal was to achieve more volume and support under the eyes in order to reduce under-eye exposure. I was informed that this could be achieved with under-eye filler. After the treatment, however, I have not observed any noticeable improvement, and the intended result was not achieved.

Afterwards, the clinic acknowledged that the outcome I had been told to expect was not achievable with under-eye filler. Had this been communicated clearly beforehand, I would not have proceeded with the treatment.

During the consultation, I felt encouraged to make a quick decision, and after initially receiving 1 cc of filler, I was advised to proceed with an additional 1 cc to achieve the desired result. The total cost of the treatment was 37,000 THB.

When I later raised my concerns, the clinic stated that a result had been achieved, based on a single low-quality photo taken in significantly different lighting. This comparison did not accurately reflect my appearance or address the concern I sought to correct.

When I requested a refund, the clinic initially offered 2,000 THB as a goodwill gesture. After I stated that I intended to share my experience so others could make an informed decision and avoid unnecessary expense, the goodwill offer was increased to 5,000 THB. However, the clinic required an in-person visit or a Thai bank account to receive the funds, despite being aware that I am no longer in Chiang Mai and do not have a Thai bank account. As a result, the offer was not practically accessible to me.

Overall, this experience left me feeling that expectations were not communicated clearly and that the outcome did not justify the cost of the treatment. For a procedure in such a sensitive area, I expected transparent guidance and realistic advice.

I am sharing this review to help others make a more informed decision.

text:
10 out 5 stars! Great clinic, excellent staff, superb doctor-will definitely be back! Received above and beyond care, excellent results!! - thread lift (nose and cheeks) and botox.

What i appreciate most - how professional everything was, from sign-in to explaining the treatment options, did not felt like i am being sold something, but was presented with options in response to my skin concerns- they listened, and explained options, the processes involved, what they professionally would recommend, the cost it involves. I was not rushed when explaining my concerns, and was given a thorough explanation of the recommended treatments. There was no push to buy services at all-more of information so i can make a decision.

The Doctor who did the procedure explained everything-the procedure, what to expect during procedure and the expected results even way before I have committed to the procedure. Aftercare was TOP NOTCH. Had to travel the next day to another city, but the clinic was in constant follow-up using whatsapp. 5 day, 7 day, 10 day and even 1 month follow-up ensuring everything was healing perfectly and as intended. This were proactive messages asking how the healing is progressing and if I had any other concerns.

I had nose and cheek thread lift done and botox injections done - excellent results! No adverse effects whatsoever ever just normal healing soreness, very minor not noticeable yellow bruising. Whats great is I had an open line communication anytime with the clinic about concerns i had and they’ve proactively contacted me to make sure healing is as expected and if I had any other concerns even if I was already in another city and eventually another country.

I highly recommend Mi-A if you are ever in Chiang Mai and thinking about skin treatments. If undecided, book a consult and talk to the team. They’re not pushy, or will not try to sell you something on the spot but will go through treatments options so you can make an informed decision just like I did.

Thank You Mi-A team!!!
